rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for claims or positions that conflict or do not fit together.

example.english: This statement is contradictory to the facts.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 tung4 si6 sat6 maau4 teon5

rows.note: Use this when something contradicts itself, especially when it contains two opposing attitudes or claims.

example.english: You say you want to leave one minute and do not want to leave the next; that is really contradictory.
example.traditional: 你一時話想走，一時又話唔想走，真係自相矛盾。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 si4 waa6 soeng2 zau2 jat1 si4 jau6 waa6 m4 soeng2 zau2 zan1 hai6 zi6 soeng1 maau4 teon5

rows.note: Use this when one thing is directly opposite to another, such as an idea being contrary to common sense.

example.english: Your idea is contradictory to mine.
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 nam2 faat3 tung4 ngo5 ge3 soeng1 faan2
